Payout of 5 August is short ₹1,417.47.
The bank credited ₹3,25,180.84 against an expected ₹3,26,598.31. 17 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000053 of ₹1,417.47, issued 12 August against payment pay_000451. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000053 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000053 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
